This '''rocky planet''' was visited by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Andur Sunrider]] and his [[Sunrider family|family]] in [[3999 BBY]]. While on their way to deliver [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]], the Sunriders were forced to land on the planet when their ship, the ''[[Lightside Explorer]]'', had a malfunction in its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. However, the problem was quickly fixed, and the Sunriders departed.
